basis: Candidate generation is separated from candidate execution, runtime proof, installation, and integration.
Exact installed Atlas lineage, requester mappings, source-file bytes, bundle bytes, request bytes, and packet bytes are independently represented.
Unknown and unrun evidence cannot be rewritten as PASS by a re-digested record.
Generation is permissionless, provider-free, networkless, and write-free.
Grounded consent binds the exact plan and resources without pretending natural-person authentication is proven.
An authenticated decision over the exact candidate bytes is required before any Nursery write.
The hand composes the existing v1.2 planner, grounded-consent scope, semantic module-bundle validator, deterministic JSON, and installed Foundry evidence.
No Foundation, Atlas, Review Inbox, materializer, executor, registry, or CANON file was replaced.
All 26 Fabric suites and all ten AGENTS.md-required checks passed.
Only one fixed bounded game-rule shape is supported; unsupported shapes fail as a typed capability gap.
Atlas and generated source remain on RESEARCH_ONLY_HOLD with direct reuse disabled.
Candidate runtime, correctness, safety, authentication, materialization, and installation remain explicit later gates.
